plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Puts a fast calibrated classifier at the harness boundaries: hands Claude a note about a risky tool call, denies the two block-grade cases once with a reason Claude can answer, flags tool results that read like prompt injection, and catches a turn that stops short of the work it was asked to do. Advisory to the agent, never a prompt to you, and fail-open.
